localLlm.modelDirectory.description: Directory for downloaded and imported GGUF models. Empty uses VS Code global extension storage.

localLlm.defaultModelId.description: Installed model ID used for inline completion and as the preferred local model.

localLlm.contextSize.description: Physical context window. Zero lets llama.cpp start from the window the model was trained with and reduce it to fit this computer. Any other value pins the window and disables that fitting.

localLlm.maxTools.description: Maximum tool definitions accepted per model request. Use the bundled Local Agent, which has a small local-only tool set.

localLlm.maxAgentToolRounds.description: How many tool calls the bundled Local Agent must make before it may answer. One completed tool call no longer ends the task.

localLlm.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum tokens generated for chat responses.

localLlm.maxToolCallTokens.description: Maximum output tokens for schema-constrained required tool decisions.

localLlm.cpuThreads.description: CPU threads for llama.cpp. Zero uses its automatic selection.

localLlm.startupTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time to wait for a model to load before reporting startup failure.

localLlm.acceleration.description: Use Metal automatically on Apple Silicon, or force CPU inference.

localLlm.batchSize.description: Logical prompt-processing batch size. Lower values reduce peak memory at the cost of prompt-processing speed.

localLlm.microBatchSize.description: Physical llama.cpp micro-batch size. This is capped at batchSize; lower values materially reduce Metal compute-graph memory.

localLlm.metalMemoryReserveMiB.description: Memory llama.cpp leaves free when fitting a model to Apple Metal. llama.cpp measures free memory as its own Metal budget minus its own allocation, so it cannot see other applications. Raise this when other software needs memory. Values below 1024 are raised to 1024, the llama.cpp default.

localLlm.inline.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens generated for an inline completion.

localLlm.inline.debounceMilliseconds.description: Delay after typing before starting a local inline completion. New edits cancel the pending request.

localLlm.logLevel.description: Diagnostic logging level. Prompt and source contents are never logged.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run typecheck && npm run build
